# Hassan Tahrioui | Technical Lead & Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Hassan Tahrioui is a technical lead and senior full-stack engineer based in Morocco, working remotely with European teams (CET-aligned, with overlap for US East Coast mornings). He has 9+ years of experience building and running commercial web software in Laravel/PHP, Next.js/React, Vue/Nuxt and Node.js, with PostgreSQL, Redis and production infrastructure. The site is available in English and French (/fr/).

## Current work

- Since 2023: Lead Full-Stack Developer for a group of football ticketing and travel brands (VisitFootball, Voetbaltrips, Voetbaltickets.nl and TrustedSeats). Responsible for technical direction, the release workflow, coordinating developers and production, while staying hands-on. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Strapi v4, Nuxt, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cloudflare, Nginx, Vercel, DigitalOcean. He is not the sole author of these platforms; they are built by a team.
- Since 2025: founder and solo developer of Tracefox (https://tracefox.co), a live SaaS for automated checkout testing aimed at ecommerce stores and the agencies that manage them.
- In development: Store Recast, a service for moving WooCommerce stores to a hosted ecommerce platform. Not yet launched.

## Availability

- Open to the right long-term role with a remote-first product team: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Technical Lead or founding engineer. Based in Morocco.
- Takes on a small number of consulting engagements: architecture reviews, production stabilization and takeovers, checkout/payments/integrations, multi-brand and multilingual platforms, SaaS builds, and fractional technical leadership for Laravel and Next.js products. Pricing is quoted per engagement after a scoping call; there are no published rates.
